summary.heading: Project Summary
summary.purpose_text: Automatically extracting financial information such as profit-share rate, term, fees, and rewards from natural-language campaign texts published on participation banks' websites, standardizing this information, and presenting it to users through a dashboard and a chatbot.
summary.problem_text: In participation banking, campaign texts are written in different formats and with different terminology, which makes manual comparison difficult. This delays both bank employees and customers in choosing the most advantageous product.
summary.solution_text: Collecting data via web scraping, preprocessing Turkish text and extracting information with regex, performing intent analysis and generating natural-language answers with the large language model provided through the competition's Evren API, converting the extracted data into a standardized, comparable format, and presenting the results to users through an interactive dashboard and a Q&A chatbot.

goals.1: Data Collection: Collect more than 100 campaign texts from the official websites of at least 5 different participation banks, covering at least 3 different product categories.
goals.2: Information Extraction Accuracy: Achieve over 90% accuracy for extracted profit-share rate, term, fee, and reward information.
goals.3: Dashboard Development: Complete an interactive dashboard with filtering and sorting features that lets users compare banks against each other.
goals.4: Chatbot Functionality: Get a chatbot working that can answer natural-language questions such as "What is Bank A's housing rate?" or "Which bank has the lowest profit share?"
goals.5: On-Premise Suitability: Verify that the system can run on a single local server without depending on external services.
